Please paste your Kubernetes YAML/JSON configurations and I'll review them for:

---

## What I'll Check

### 🔒 Security
- Privileged containers
- Running as root
- Missing security contexts
- Overly permissive RBAC
- Exposed secrets in plain text
- Host network/PID/IPC sharing

### ⚙️ Resource Management
- Missing resource requests/limits
- Improper HPA configuration
- LimitRange issues

### 🏥 Reliability
- Missing health probes (liveness/readiness/startup)
- Single replica deployments
- Missing pod disruption budgets
- Poor restart policies

### 🏷️ Configuration Best Practices
- Missing labels/annotations
- Hardcoded image tags (`:latest`)
- Improper namespace usage
- Missing pod anti-affinity rules

### 🌐 Networking
- Service misconfiguration
- Ingress issues
- NetworkPolicy gaps

---

## How to Share
```bash
# Export existing configs
kubectl get deployment <name> -o yaml
kubectl get all -n <namespace> -o yaml
```

**Paste your configs and I'll get started!** 🚀
